usage.templates: The template marked In use is the one the business flow applies to its product: motor quotations are priced with the motor pricing template; its acceptance rules, rating factors, insurer market and document templates take effect on quotations, Requests for Quotation, placements and printed documents.
usage.coverages: Covers of each product template. For the covers quoted (Priced on quotation as), the deductible and main exclusions are printed as Cover terms on the quotation slip and the policy schedule. Cover premiums themselves are priced on the quotation screens with the template's motor tariff.
usage.rating: Rating factors adjust the net premium of a quotation of the template in use: the factor of the band the risk falls in multiplies the premium (Multiplicative, Discount) or adds a percentage (Additive). A factor applies only when the quotation carries its field, for example the vehicle's model year for vehicle age.
usage.underwriting: Insurer underwriting guidelines, checked when a quotation is priced or saved, when a Request for Quotation approaches an insurer and when a placement is created. Auto-accept passes the risk when the condition holds and otherwise refers (or declines) it; Refer holds the quotation until a user of the authority role approves it within the authority matrix (Underwriting referral approval); Decline refuses it with the message; Apply loading adds the loading to the net premium. A rule applies to all insurers or to one insurer.
usage.documents: Document templates of each product template, printed from the policy and quotation screens and attached to e-mails. Upload a layout (text file with merge fields) to replace the standard layout of the policy schedule, quotation slip, CTPL certificate or member enrollment form; without an upload the standard layout is printed.
usage.marketMapping: The insurers that offer each product. Only insurers on a product's market (the template's insurer panel and the active mappings here) can be approached on a Request for Quotation. Year-to-date production is computed from the policies issued; the agreed commission is a reference, commission itself comes from the Commission Rate Matrix.
usage.analytics: Computed from the policies issued and the claims recorded (cancelled policies and rejected claims left out).
